unchanged_definition.cache: key every authority/ref/edge/purpose/invocation; no capacity reset; exhaustion discards whole invocation
unchanged_definition.parser: Complete original native authority schema source reader bounded by bytes/tokens/nodes/depth; projected proof lists retain512. Unique keys; aliases/cycles/unsupported syntax deny. No native schema/list limit increase or source truncation.
unchanged_definition.post_work_deadline: observed monotonic elapsed_ns, ceiling milliseconds; never clamp

units.commits: actual traversal visits, including repeated visits
units.comparison_bytes: every compared byte pair charged by bytes on both sides
units.decoded_bytes: actual native recovered bytes before cache insertion
units.git_operations: every started immutable read including failure
units.json_nodes: keys + values + array children and containers
units.list_entries: each projected custody proof list; exact native original-authority schema source-list rules and ordinary execution cap unchanged
units.output_bytes: actual UTF8 serialized result, before publication
